shortDescription.en: The book introduces Ishmael's voyage aboard the Pequod. Its discussion turns to Captain Ahab's pursuit. Another section examines the white whale. The source also develops life aboard a whaling ship. A later passage addresses obsession and revenge. Together, these subjects frame the book’s fiction focus.

en: The book begins with Ishmael's voyage aboard the Pequod and then sets it beside Captain Ahab's pursuit. Its sections give distinct attention to the white whale, tracing how these ideas or events enter the wider subject. The order places the first two topics before the more detailed discussion that follows.

Later material discusses life aboard a whaling ship and obsession and revenge. These strands establish the book’s scope and help readers decide where to begin. The sequence of topics makes clear which questions or events receive sustained attention in the text.
fr: Le texte commence par Ishmael's voyage aboard the Pequod, puis le rapproche de Captain Ahab's pursuit. Ses sections accordent une attention particulière à the white whale et situent ces idées ou événements dans le sujet général. Cet ordre fait précéder la discussion détaillée par les deux premiers thèmes.

La suite traite de life aboard a whaling ship et de obsession and revenge. Ces fils montrent l’étendue du livre et aident à choisir un point de départ. La progression indique les questions ou événements auxquels le texte accorde une attention soutenue.
